_comment: Spec 38 (Motion System) FR-38-24 bundle-size budget baseline.
These are MEASURED (gzip, bytes) build actuals recorded via --update-baseline — NOT the Spec 38 section 4.4 table (which is an ESTIMATE, see script docstring).

2026-07-31 re-baseline, cited reason: shared/effects/gsap/fx-draggable.js 553 -> 857 gzip (+55%). The module was rewritten to stop using GSAP Draggable's type:'scroll' mode, which re-parents a scroller's children into a wrapper div (gsap/Draggable.js:536) and so destroyed the grid-based sgs/gallery carousel track (measured live: an 8-slide track collapsed to a single 389px column). It now drives scrollLeft from pointer events with InertiaPlugin as the release physics, which is more of our own code and less of GSAP's -- hence the growth. It also DROPS the Draggable plugin from the effect's plugin_set, so the page-level cost fell by ~13KB gzip; this +304 bytes is a net saving of about 12.7KB on any page using the effect.
